question: Should agent activity/status dashboard widgets proceed through the linked modular-dashboard PR path, or should maintainers require a narrower current-main dashboard surface first?
rationale: This is new dashboard product/API surface with an open contributor PR already claiming the work, so automation should not close it or start a competing fix PR before maintainer direction is clear.

options.title: Review linked ops-widget PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the current implementation candidate.

options.title: Request a narrower proposal
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a smaller implementation shape that fits current main before accepting code.

options.title: Reject this dashboard direction
options.body: Close this issue and associated dashboard PRs only if maintainers decide the feature should not ship in OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Review linked ops-widget PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the current implementation candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses current sessions-list behavior and Control UI product surface, and this owner has the strongest current history signal for those foundations.
